blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd), led by Secretary Sonny Angara, has spearheaded partnerships with state agencies, local government units (LGUs), and the private sector to modernize public school infrastructure and expand digital connectivity nationwide. The partnerships aim to address two critical challenges facing the basic education system — a classroom shortage and learning disruptions caused by weather-related emergencies. According to its statement on Thursday, DepEd has signed a memorandum of agreement with the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corp. (Pagcor) and 49 local government units to build new public school facilities in target communities nationwide. READ: DepEd completes partnerships […]...
